divergences.title: Untrusted prize self-reports stand in for escrow and delivery
A future clone address defeats destination invariants
The sponsor can close an empty raffle before its deadline
Frontend fresh-state rereads are absent from the frozen target

documentProblems: DESIGN.md treats arbitrary prize contracts as untrusted, while IRaffle assumes supported prizes are honest, standards-compliant ERC-721s.
The stated refund deadline omits the documented sponsor-only immediate closure of an empty raffle.
The term “sponsor” is ambiguous because the ABI separates the depositor from the immutable sponsorRecipient that receives proceeds and returned prizes.
The frontend reread requirement identifies no frontend repository or revision within the frozen target.

DESIGN.md omits 11 consequential operational behaviors, including creation bounds, draw funding, callback handling, refund batching, release timing, prize delivery semantics, and unsolicited-NFT handling.
